value.answer: For soccer, I'd go with Messi. He has eight Ballon d'Or awards to Ronaldo's five, and the latest coverage I found leans his way, especially after his World Cup run. In the NFL, Brady is still the usual pick with 7 Super Bowl wins, though Mahomes is the one chasing him.
